name: Tyndall AFB
description: Home of the 325th Fighter Wing, Tyndall AFB trains and projects F-35A air dominance capabilities for the combat Air Force. The installation is undergoing a multi-billion-dollar rebuild following catastrophic damage from Hurricane Michael in October 2018, with new gate complexes, lodging, flightline facilities, and community infrastructure delivered through AFCEC's Natural Disaster Recovery program.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass — Trusted Traveler Program suspended.

currentNotifications.title: Trusted Traveler Program Suspended
currentNotifications.body: The Trusted Traveler Program at Tyndall is suspended until further notice. Vouching for passengers at the gate is no longer authorized. All non-DoD affiliated guests must be processed at the VCC for a background check and installation pass.

currentNotifications.title: Hurricane Michael Recovery Underway
currentNotifications.body: Tyndall AFB continues post-Hurricane Michael reconstruction. Some facilities remain in temporary locations and construction may affect traffic patterns. Check the base status page and tyndallfss.com for current facility hours.

gates.name: Tyndall Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with new gate complex completed January 2025 as part of hurricane recovery. Visitor passes can be issued after VCC hours.

gates.name: Airey Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access. Issues visitor passes when VCC is closed — all non-DoD guests require vetting.

gates.name: Sabre Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 housing-area gate. Visitor Control Center located near Sabre Dr and Roosevelt Blvd off US Hwy 98.

gates.name: Commercial Gate
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle gate closed. Use Cleveland Gate (CVIA) for commercial traffic during posted hours.

gates.name: Cleveland Gate (CVIA)
gates.notes: Commercial vehicles only. Closed weekends and federal holidays.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (VCC)
gates.notes: Visitor passes and vetting for all non-DoD guests. Trusted Traveler suspended — no vouching at gate. After-hours passes issued at Airey Gate. REAL ID required.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance in Bldg 662 for travel voucher settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. New lodging facility available for temporary stays — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Tyndall, Airey, and Sabre Gates are open 24/7. Cleveland Gate (CVIA) is Mon-Fri 0600-1600 for commercial vehicles only. Commercial Gate is closed. VCC hours are Mon-Fri 0630-1530 — after-hours visitor passes at Airey Gate. Trusted Traveler suspended; all guests require VCC vetting. REAL ID required.

sections.title: Hurricane Recovery
sections.body: Tyndall is rebuilding after Hurricane Michael (October 2018). Expect construction traffic, temporary facility relocations, and evolving gate infrastructure. New Tyndall and Airey gate complexes opened in 2025; Community Commons and chapel projects continue in 2026.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource for relocation support during the rebuild.
